budget_rule: max(median largest checkpoint bytes, round(0.25 * median keep-all peak bytes)) from the selected outcome-blind screen cell; this fixed byte capacity is then used for every confirmatory case.
selection_rule: Among eligible cells choose lexicographically largest (median repair-search milliseconds per decision, median fraction of iterations with >=4 live checkpoints, median peak live checkpoints). No learned-policy, work-saving, wall-clock-policy, or objective outcome enters selection.
